Hi, I love your art style. I would be very happy if you could accept my request.
This would be for a Youtube singing video so I would really appreciate if the ratio is 16:9 (or bigger).

My OC character is a girl but looks like a handsome boy (イケメン).

OC is a teenager escaping from bad people.
Some bruises show due to the torment.
OC's hair and clothes are messy from escaping.

I would like to request 2 variations:
1) OC with eyes closed: A version with only one purplish sparkly translucent tear falling down from the red eye side and without.
2) OC with eyes open: Same as #1 but with more tears.

For the lighting idea, please refer to the general reference image. You can choose the background.

References:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yrQQmE7yZPB59JyzzYvAIG8z-ehXCaFQ?usp=sharing

Please feel free to create and make adjustments.

If possible, please also include a PSD with the character, background, and signature as separate layers.

Thank you for considering my request!

こんにちはクリスマスの依頼で、私がサンタの衣装（ElectricSerg）、Puppispitがトナカイの衣装を着るというのをやってもらいたかったんです。ケーキを一切れ持って、フォークで一口ケーキを差し出し、画面に向かって手を伸ばし（写真を見ている人に向かっていくような）、餌をあげているように見せたいのです。パピピットは、私の隣で少し後ろにいて、首輪とジングルベルのついたトナカイの服を着て、赤いライトアップされた鼻（赤鼻のトナカイのルドルフのような）を持っていてほしいです。背景は好きなように描いてください。あなたのアートスタイルがとても好きなので、これがあなたにできることであることを望みます。

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Adl1LjLPmgJ5j_yHWv45a2RX6zPOrsJi/view?usp=share_link

なので可能であればサイン無しの納品もお願いします。

Hello! I really love you the last artwork you drew for my character. It would be an honour to work with you again.

I would like the size of the art to be a 16:9 size. Please draw the art in portrait/vertical format.

Please draw her position and expression with all your freedom you desire. You can also make her hold the props in her reference sheet if you desire. 

Please feel free to explore the art with all the freedom you need! Thank you so much for your time.

(Please keep in mind the birthmark on my character's breasts and her face!)
Reference for my character: https://imgur.com/a/giGpPc8

It is nice to meet you.
I was introduced to you by a friend and saw your illustration.
I like your illustration so much that I have decided to commission you to do the illustration.

Request
I would like you to illustrate my avatar in a VR game called VRChat and the avatar of a friend of mine.

▽Composition/Situation
The ratio of the image should be 16:9 or 9:16 as I would like to use it on a disk top or a lock screen of my phone.
We would be happy if the two people are depicted from the waist up.
We are not particular about the background.
As for the situation, we would like to have a drawing of two people wearing matching clothes and having fun.

The one with horns (Ryuga) is energetic, always smiling, and loves EVESON.
He is a water dragon, so his arms and legs are not human-shaped.
His body is covered with blue scales, and his mouth and tongue are also blue.

On the other hand, the silver-haired and red-eyed one (EVESON) is an android with a quiet smile.
In image, he is like 2B of NieR: Automata.
▽Resources
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-1ueYVD-x4UZVLqweeSgo5hWTQEC50sK?usp=sharing

Matching dock tag style necklace.
https://booth.pm/ja/items/3796171
Matching clothes.
https://booth.pm/ja/items/3771374
Matching bracelets.
https://twitter.com/3pond_rond/status/1470671158391762944

▽Use outside of Skeb regulations.
We would appreciate your permission to use the following
Use of cropped images as icons on VRChat, SNS sites, etc.
Displaying unedited images on my personal SNS or VRChat private world (*non-commercial use)

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-1ueYVD-x4UZVLqweeSgo5hWTQEC50sK?usp=sharing

hello, nice to meet you! 

if possible, i would like to request a illustration of my original character! this character could become a vtuber model in the future, so if that isn't okay, please feel free to reject this request. this will likely be used on social media (twitter, twitch, discord).

my character is a quiet, doll-like girl who was a black cat in a past life. please feel free to draw her in any pose! she usually wears gothic lolita style dresses/clothing. there are some examples in the reference.

some key points: 
- glowing, red eyes 
- hair clip and hair bow
- bandages
- cat bell collar
- mole under the left eye and under her mouth 
- many ear piercings 
- thin eyebrows 
- short bangs
- curly, short hair
- black cat doll

i have included some references. i hope they are not too confusing!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ts_9s9BrYcn-AqSHc5QpYRmFrSARsVOD?usp=sharing
